text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She's gotten even stronger. If I planted a
single
foot wrong, I would've lost.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: That was a brilliant call, as expe...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Was that really my best out there? Was
that
enough to prove that I'm number
one—that I'd
never lose to Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You can't just answer a question with
another
question! Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm still not satisfied. That's my answer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's decide on our next goal. I
want to
keep this momentum going.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: How about the Queen Elizabeth II Cup?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Today, I wanted to beat you more than I
wanted
to get first place.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Losin' ain't my style.
So I'll see you in the
next
race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is just
around the
corner. I'll be waitin' for ya
there.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: Shall we register for the race?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And I'll go ahead and beat her in that
race too!
